candidates.description: Change the repository to return the DTO directly via a constructor‑expression projection, eliminating per‑row Invoice entity hydration. Update the service to return the repository result unchanged, removing the manual mapping loop.
candidates.predicted_effect: entity allocations drop from up to 100 per request to 0 (only DTOs are allocated)
what_could_break: Any other code that calls findByStatusOnly expecting Invoice entities will now receive DTOs, causing ClassCastException.
If lazy‑loaded associations on Invoice were ever accessed (they are not in this endpoint), they will no longer be available.

what_could_break: If the Afterburner module is incompatible with the current Jackson version, serialization could fail at runtime.
